summary: StageWise Strategies Corp. (STWI, a Nevada shell with a non-US address in Tashkent) filed an 8-K disclosing an October 6, 2026 Share Exchange Agreement to acquire 99.99999012% of TEG SPV LLC from Tourism and Entertainment Group LLC (67.99999012%) and individual Irodakhon Abduvakhitova (32%). Consideration is 183,098,434 newly issued STWI shares (124,506,935 to TEG Parent, 58,591,499 to the individual), representing approximately 97.3% of the 188,142,768 shares outstanding post-close. The board approved; holders of about 79.3% consented by written consent per a September 18, 2026 Schedule 14C information statement. A concurrent financing is contemplated. Watch post-close float, Uzbek registration, and financing terms in what is effectively a reverse merger.
